title: AMCA Installation Type Sorter
description: Eight illustrative fan installations, shuffled: the learner answers whether each side is ducted, places the description in the Type A, B, C or D bin and commits it, then sees the Why text, a schematic of the correct answer and, at the end, the bins with their correct contents.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: AMCA installation type

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: AMCA installation types A, B, C and D
learningObjectives: The learner will classify fan installations into AMCA installation types A, B, C and D from a description of what is connected to the fan's inlet and outlet, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt.

accessibility.notes: describe() text (fallback mode); each description, every verdict and the end summary announced through FP.announce (aria-live); ✓/✗ glyphs and solid/dashed borders pair with colour; Yes/No answers are native radio groups with aria-labels; keys A-D choose a bin and Enter commits or goes on; focus moves to Next after a commit and to Start over at the end; controls stay inside the canvas at 320 px.

controls.label: Inlet ducted?
controls.purpose: Predict whether the inlet is ducted (No, free / Yes, ducted)

controls.label: Outlet ducted?
controls.purpose: Predict whether the outlet is ducted (No, free / Yes, ducted)

controls.label: Type A / Type B / Type C / Type D
Commit
controls.purpose: Commit the bin (Enter); the first commit is scored, one unscored commit after a miss

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Reshuffle the eight descriptions and clear the score

rules: Inlet ducted No / outlet ducted No = Type A; No / Yes = Type B; Yes / No = Type C; Yes / Yes = Type D
A cabinet, plenum or room is open space, not a duct
One scored commit per description; after a miss one unscored practice commit
Mastery: 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt
assumptions: Installation types follow the four types of the AMCA 210 test standard
limitations: The descriptions are illustrative installations, not specific jobs
The sim classifies the installation only; it does not size the system effect

sources: Installation type definitions: AMCA 210 test standard (standard engineering knowledge), as stated in Chapter 25
Descriptions: illustrative installations written for Chapter 25 from fan types in Chapters 5, 6 and 18

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict each side (free or ducted) before committing a bin; immediate feedback with the reason; end review of the bins
keyQuestions: Does the catalog rating's installation type match the job's?
commonMisconceptions: The installation type depends on the fan type rather than on the connections
A short connection to a plenum or cabinet counts as a ducted side
Exhaust fans are always Type C
assessmentOpportunities: Running score shown as 'Correct on first try: n of 8'; mastery is 7 of 8 on the first attempt.
